lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the mid-lateral flank. The centroids are arranged in a staggered grid pattern with highest density in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a structured grid where each blob is centered within a vertical stripe.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity leading edge and a dark shadow-cast gradient below, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: A pale, elongated, and bifurcated high-luminance object is visible at the posterior ventral insertion point of the left pectoral fin.
